retired.Amendment G blockage suite: Retired for construct-validity failure before any evaluation arm ran. Its 200-scenario evaluation pool was never run on by any arm and is NOT published: nothing in the paper is computed from it. It is exactly regenerable with py/make_blockage_suite.py from the accepted seed list in gblock_manifest.json, both of which are committed. The calibration pool it was screened on (export_gblock_calib/) IS published, because results were computed from it. Neither pool may be repurposed: both carry the retired design's assumptions.
retired.Amendment G2 evaluation pool: 150 scenarios, generated and geometrically validated (manipulation check 200/200) but never run on by any arm following the negative calibration result. NOT published, for the same reason: no reported result depends on it. Exactly regenerable with py/make_g2_suite.py from the accepted seed list in g2_manifest.json, both committed. The 50-scenario calibration pool (export_g2_calib/) IS published.

publication_policy: Scenario pools are published where a reported result was computed from them. Pools that no arm ever ran on are omitted and regenerated from generator + manifest seeds. One exception: export_fcal/ (Amendment F calibration, 160 scenarios) is published IN FULL because its generator was not retained and fcal_manifest.json records only a seed range, not the accepted seed list, so it is not regenerable from this repository.
